name: Volumetric Path Tracing
definition: A basic volumetric path tracer that uses simple sampling techniques (delta tracking) and does not perform explicit light sampling or handle surface scattering. It is used for computing ground-truth results when debugging more sophisticated algorithms.
summary: Volumetric Path Tracing is a stochastic Monte Carlo method for simulating light in participating media using delta tracking, distinguished by its lack of explicit light sampling and surface scattering support.
